title: BlenderBot 3: a deployed conversational agent that continually learns to responsibly engage
findings: Using the Likelihood Bias metric from the HolisticBias benchmark, the paper found a slight reduction in bias related to religious terms for the larger 175B-parameter models (OPT-175B and BB3-175B) compared to the smaller BB3-3B model. The bias scores for the Religion axis were 80% for BB3-3B, 74% for OPT-175B, and 76% for BB3-175B.
